ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white (>200 RGB) to low-intensity black (<50 RGB) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blobs dominate the medial regions of both lobes, bifurcated by a low-intensity black central wedge. Outer lateral margins and the trailing edge are defined by a continuous low-intensity black border. A single, distinct low-intensity circular spot is located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees forming a sharp V-shaped depression at the central convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by sharp pixel-peaks and deep valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased complexity and jaggedness towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges of both lobes follow a convex curve that terminates in heavily irregular, serrated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of dark, high-relief pixel groupings (barnacles) concentrated at the distal-most tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation and stalked barnacle clusters causing significant geometric distortion and 'fringing' at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique cluster of stalked, dark-brown organic structures (Conchoderma auritum) extending visibly beyond the natural pixel-boundary of the right fluke tip.
